name: Full cart flow (text): browse → product → qty → add more → confirm → pickup time
description: End-to-end multi-item order flow using text-only browsing (numbered lists + typed numbers). Final confirmation uses DA/NU template when available.

steps.note: Browse text — should send category picker as numbered list
Select 5th category — should send product list as numbered list
Select first product — should send qty prompt as text
Enter qty 2 — must show cart summary with add-more/confirm options
Choose add more (1) — should send category picker again
Select 3rd category — should send a product list as numbered list
Select first product — should send qty prompt as text
Enter qty 3 — cart now has 2 items, must show add-more/confirm
Choose confirm cart (2) — must ask for pickup time
Provide pickup time — must send order confirmation template or confirmation text
